notes.title: Demo + 1.0 Release Date
notes.notes:
Hello Fellow Tinnies!

We are happy to announce our official 1.0 release date, coming up on May 12th at 1pm ET.
To go along with this announcement we have just released a free demo. It contains our new four tutorials, allowing you to learn the fundamentals of Tin Can before diving head first into the cosmos!

For the past few months we have been hard at work improving the game and adding new content in order to get ready for this release.
It has been a long journey and our small team is honored to be working with the community to improve Tin Can and shape it into what it is becoming.

A version of the game containing our last additions and changes is now available on our beta branch and we are looking for feedback in order to spend the next few weeks working on the last improvements before pushing it on the main branch.
If you wish to help us, feel free to join our Discord where you will find instructions to access the beta branch!

Please note that we are proceeding step by step. We are currently focusing on the non-VR version of Tin Can. As such, both the demo and the new beta are not currently available in VR. VR will be updated as we get closer to the official release.

We would also like to make it clear than Tin Can 1.0 will not be the end of the road for this adventure. We have more things planned and we invite you to keep an eye open after release not to miss future announcements.

Have fun in space!

The Tin Can Team

notes.title: Next Update - Rescue Mode!
notes.notes:
Hello fellow astronauts,

Here is some news from space for you.
We are currently working hard on the next update : Rescue Mode.
This gamemode will be quite different from what you've experienced so far with the normal and hardcore modes.
You will have to survive a dozen scenarios, each longer and harder, in order to finally be rescued by another ship.
Yes you heard that right! You will finally be able to survive this cosmic nightmare!
You will start in your original ship, right before the evacuation. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37799723/e1131a9b3dfacf1f37c2af587ba49a7a2a75e3df.png
You will be given a limited amount of time to flee the burning wreck before it explodes. Bring as many components and tools as you need to survive and eject yourself. But be careful, you never know in what state your good old pod was left after its last maintenance. Some components might be missing, others could be damaged. It's always better to check first, if you are fast enough!
You will also have to maintain a beacon online in order for the rescue ship to find you. Anytime it stops working, the timer stops as well.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37799723/42327159e520d330c0e2f1bcb87c34d23ed1f1d0.jpg
Each level unlocks new events and components, allowing you to go through a smooth progression until the very end. Maybe you'll get to go home once you are done after all!

Oh and unlocking all scenarios will open a new tab "Scenario Editor". This editor will allow you to create your own custom scenarios, from starting pod condition to events, and ship content.

We will keep you informed as soon as the beta branch is updated with the new content!

See you soon in space,

The Tin Can Team

notes.title: Update 3 - 0.0.66
notes.notes:
Hello fellow astronauts!

We just released the update 0.0.66!
Face new challenges with the addition of fire and leaks!

Sparks will eventually turn into flames, depending on the amount of oxygen and carbon dioxide in the atmosphere, as well as pressure. Flames will convert O2 in CO2, and generate heat, and will slowly destroy affected components! You'll have to grab your fire extinguisher and act quickly! Or you could just open the airlock...

Leaks will show up from time to time, whether because of a space collision or if you are not careful with your pod's internal pressure. You'll have to react quickly to locate them and fix them to avoid losing your atmosphere!

The update also brings new storage drawers! Some random components will be placed inside every single time you start a game as a little extra to make it a bit further.

Various other improvements have been made since the last update. If you are interested in the full list you can go and take a look at the changelog in the Steam discussion thread.

We are now focusing on the next update : Rescue Mode!

Rescue mode will finally allow you to avoid death, if you can make it far enough. A rescue ship will eventually find you and get you to safety, away from your badly designed pod. You will also be able to start the game before your initial ship's explosion, giving you a limited amount of time to do a diagnostic of your pod and to collect whatever components you can get your hands on.

We can't wait for you guys to try it out!

See you out there in space!

The Tin Can Team

notes.title: Update 1 : Random Events, Debug, Option Menu
notes.notes:
Hello fellow Tinnies,

The game has now been released for a couple weeks and we've been hard at work fixing the early bugs you have reported, balancing the game and adding a much needed option menu (with also volume and FOV sliders and inverted mouse) as well as random events for the hardcore mode.

We are now working on adding more languages to the game, a basic tutorial, more debug and then we'll start working on Rescue Mode and Storage Spaces. Do not hesitate to come and give us feedback on the update on discord : https://discord.gg/pqyVX53RUj (And come take a look at the roadmap)!

Leaderboard has been reset, so now is your time to shine :O !

You can find the complete changelog below :

10/30/2020 :
Fixed :
-Unity video player crashing the game when playing videos for players using windows 7

11/01/2020 :
Fixed :
-Bottles should not longer be filled and emptied by magic resources
-You should be able to get the missing achievements (just die in hardcore to trigger them)
-Ranking is no longer broken

11/02/2020 :
Fixed :
-Leaderboard no longer crashes the game because of three guys named Bob (Should not happen again)

11/03/2020 :
Fixed :
-Repair Station should no longer crash when inserting weird things in it (No, you can't fix the atomilc pile shield!)
-Air filters wont crash anymore when repaired (This fixes the CO2 Scrubber not working anymore)
-Bottles wont fill or empty themselves at crazy rates. Everything is now in a logical closed circuit.

11/04/2020 :
Fixed :
-Corrected in FR (Ne dit plus trop de CO2 pour trop de O2 sur le moniteur d'oxygène)
-Both Oxy and CO2 now say On_Batt
-Can't be electrocuted anymore by systems if they don't have a power connector
-No more ghost asteroids after the star event
-Display no longer stay on in the air on the main comp if you remove monitor
-Collisions fixed (until you find more holes)
-New code for Pause Menu (should prevent lots of bugs)
-Resume button added on pause menu
-Issue where getting electrocuted while holding manual was a problem is now fixed
-Repair button no longer stays on while system is offline
-Main computer no longer needs a monitor to boot
-No more "streamer demo" text on the pause menu

11/07/2020 (Beta branch) :
Fixed :
-Bottles will now be closed automatically when inserted inside a system or if empty.
-Issue where you could not plug a component when holding the manual
-Diamond rank will no longer crash the leaderboard
-Having controllers plugged no longer cause issues with inputs.
Added :
-Option Menu!!
-Random Events!!

11/10/2020 (Beta branch) :
Fixed :
-Hopefully the weird temperature bugs should be gone but we need you to confirm it.
Changed :
-Components now give a different amount of parts to push you into dismantling more of the ship and think things through.
Added :
-FOV option
-Summon events in Sandbox
-Watch stats in Sandbox
-Stop your pod from being damaged in Sandbox

0.0.62e (Beta branch)
11/11/2020 :
Fixed :
-Keybinding not working
-No Inputs for some users
-Bottles still detected by systems after removing them
-Option menu scaling incorrectly
-No delay before asteroids
-Temperature balance
-A bunch of typos
-Electrocution not ocurring, randomly

0.0.62f (Beta branch)
11/12/2020 :
Fixed :
-Progress bar of the main computer is working again
-Error Bad_Fuse no longer remains when removing a damaged fuse
-Problems with events and their cycle
-Game crashing after 48 minutes in hardcore
-Objects can't be accidentally grabbed when leaving pause
-All batteries are now turned towards the player when grabbed
Added :
-A different image shows up during electrocution if the fuse is missing from the system
-New options in Sandbox (Timescale, fixed temperature, fixed atmo and so on)
Modified :
-Different heating rate of transformers

0.0.62g (Beta branch) :
Fixed :
-Repair station can no longer be broken by opening the door, grabbing the component and mashing F on the repair button (You guys are nuts)
-Broken monitors no longer display stuff on the main computer
-Normal mode no longer starts with 3 asteroid fields in a row
-Back to normal difficulty in normal mode

See you soon in space!
